### How to Escape Temptation
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B240614/how-to-escape-temptation
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:13
Points:
- The way of escape provided by God is to endure trials without yielding to sin.
- Testing is intended to produce spiritual maturity and endurance rather than an easy exit.
- Believers can withstand temptation through meditating on scripture, persistent prayer, and actively resisting Satan.
- Genuine faith looks to Jesus, who endured severe hostility and sympathizes with human weaknesses.

### Staying Alert Against Temptation (1 Corinthians 10:13) - Your Daily Bible Verse - November 7
Author: Betsy St. Amant Haddox
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-november-7.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:13
Points:
- Experiencing temptation is not itself a sin, as shown by Christ's own wilderness testing.
- Believers can take comfort knowing their struggles are common to all people and understood by Jesus.
- Sin occurs only when a person surrenders to deceptive desires and acts on them.
- Christians should maintain a proactive plan to flee temptation through scripture and submission to God.

### When Temptation Comes Knocking
Author: Melissa Kruger
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/temptation-comes-knocking
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:13
Points:
- Recognizing that our temptations are common silences self-pity and prideful excuses for disobedience.
- Other believers have faced similar trials and faithfully endured by the Holy Spirit.
- God sovereignly orders circumstances and provides the strength necessary to withstand trials.
- God's commandments are life-giving blessings rather than impossible burdens.

### God's Wilderness Provisions
Author: L. Michael Morales
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-wilderness-provisions
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:5
Points:
- Israel's failure in the wilderness serves as a solemn warning against presuming upon God's grace.
- The New Testament depicts the Christian life as a wilderness journey that demands perseverance.
- The supernatural water and manna in the desert were provisions mediated by Christ Himself.
- Faithful endurance requires cherishing God's ordinary means of grace, including Word, sacrament, and fellowship.
